TUTORIAL_BODY_1:
[gold]Mana[/gold] is the resource spent on [gold]Chant[/gold]. Playing [gold]Mana[/gold] from your [gold]Hand[/gold] is called [gold]Synchro[/gold]: draw 1 card, then [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the [gold]Mana[/gold].

Your starting relic, Holy Emblem, adds 1 [gold]Mana[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] at the start of each turn.

The counters beside [gold]Mana[/gold] show how much [gold]Mana[/gold] is in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
TUTORIAL_BODY_2:
You have three slots for Magic Factors. Each Factor describes the cost and reward of a [gold]Chant[/gold].

For [gold]Chant[/gold] 1, replace X with 1. Choose any pile that has enough [gold]Mana[/gold] to pay its Factor. Only that pile pays.

The Factors shown cost X, 2X, and 6X [gold]Mana[/gold]. For [gold]Chant[/gold] 2, you need 2 [gold]Mana[/gold] in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], 4 in your [gold]Hand[/gold], or 12 in your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
TUTORIAL_BODY_3:
Click the [gold]Magic Deck[/gold] [img=32x32]res://FrierenMod/images/ui/magic_deck.png[/img] icon in the top right to view your Factors and Tools.

Right-click a Tool, then left-click its targets to use it. Right-click the selected Tool again or press Esc to cancel.

Combat rewards may include new Factors and Tools. In the [gold]Magic Deck[/gold] [img=32x32]res://FrierenMod/images/ui/magic_deck.png[/img], click Tutorial to review these instructions, or Achievements & Card Backs to change your slot backgrounds.
